name: VenR (Venetoclax + Rituximab), fixed duration

institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard-of-care dosing (experimental; owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Rituximab infusion-reaction prophylaxis
premedications.notes: antihistamine, antipyretic and (per practice) a corticosteroid before the infusion.

premedications.name: Tumor-lysis-syndrome prophylaxis
premedications.notes: hydration and a uric-acid-lowering agent around the venetoclax ramp-up; risk-stratify by tumor burden and renal function.

supportiveCare: Relapsed/refractory fixed-duration regimen: rituximab for 6 monthly doses with venetoclax continued for about 24 months total.
Tumor-lysis-syndrome assessment with hydration and the weekly venetoclax ramp-up before the 400 mg target dose.
Hepatitis B reactivation prophylaxis if HBcAb-positive (anti-CD20 antibody).
Antiviral and PJP prophylaxis per risk.
monitoring: Tumor-lysis labs during each venetoclax step-up, per a defined schedule

doseModificationRules.condition: laboratory or clinical tumor lysis during ramp-up
doseModificationRules.text: Hold venetoclax, correct the metabolic abnormality, and resume the ramp-up per standard practice; physician decides.

drugs.name: Venetoclax
drugs.notes: Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita, general reference): oral daily, started as a 5-week ramp-up (20 mg, then 50, 100, 200, 400 mg, escalating weekly) to reduce tumor-lysis risk, then 400 mg once daily continued to complete about 24 months of therapy in the relapsed/refractory setting. dosePerUnit is the 400 mg maintenance dose. Own wording; not copied from any source.

drugs.name: Rituximab
drugs.notes: Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita, general reference): 375 mg/m2 IV on day 1 of the first cycle, then 500 mg/m2 IV on day 1 of cycles 2 through 6 (6 monthly doses total). dosePerUnit is the first-cycle 375 mg/m2 dose; the 500 mg/m2 escalation from cycle 2 is noted here. Rituximab begins after the venetoclax ramp-up reaches the 400 mg dose. Own wording; not copied from any source.
